[[File:No More Deportations Shut Down the Broadview ICE Facility 9 27 2025 20250927 3443 (54816991375).jpg|thumb|right|200px|ICE agents on the roof of the facility during protests on September 27, 2025]]

The '''Broadview ICE Facility'''<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Thrush |first1=Charles |last2=Giangreco |first2=Leigh |last3=Hernandez |first3=Alex V. |date=2025-09-19 |title=Agents Tear Gas, Detain Demonstrators Outside Broadview ICE Facility During Friday Protest |url=https://blockclubchicago.org/2025/09/19/ice-tear-gasses-detains-protesters-outside-broadview-facility/ |access-date=2025-10-11 |website=Block Club Chicago |language=en-US}}</ref> or '''Broadview ICE Detention Center''',<ref>{{Cite web |last1=FitzPatrick |first1=Lauren |last2=Cardona-Maguigad |first2=Adriana |date=2025-10-01 |title=ICE's Broadview facility has become a de facto detention center, minus the rules and oversight |url=https://www.wbez.org/immigration/2025/10/01/broadview-immigration-processing-center-detention-ice-dhs |access-date=2025-10-11 |website=WBEZ |language=en-US}}</ref> officially the '''Broadview Processing Center''', is a facility operated by [[US Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] in [[Broadview, Illinois]].<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Chiarito |first1=Robert |last2=Bosman |first2=Julie |date=2025-09-19 |title=Protesters and Federal Agents Clash Outside an ICE Detention Facility Near Chicago |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/09/19/us/politics/ice-protests-chicago.html |work=The New York Times |access-date=2025-10-11 |language=en}}</ref>

==History==
{{Expand section|date=October 2025}}
The facility was constructed in the 1970s<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.landmarks.org/1930-beach-street-broadview/ |title=1930 Beach Street Broadview |website=Landmarks Illinois |access-date=2025-10-12}}</ref> and had been an immigration-related facility since 2006.<ref>{{cite news |last=Chiarito |first=Bob |date=2025-09-29 |url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/business/2025/09/29/broadview-businesses-ice-immigration-protest-suburbs |title=Neighbors of Broadview ICE facility say they're stuck in clashes between protesters, feds |work=Chicago Sun-Times |access-date=2025-10-12}}</ref> In 2017, the facility stopped processing all Mexico-bound detainees and transferred this task to a different facility {{convert|70 |miles}} south.<ref>{{cite news |last=Yousef |first=Odette |date=2017-03-08 |url=https://www.wbez.org/shows/wbez-news/quiet-shift-in-deportation-centers-alarms-local-attorneys-families/dc6f478f-a02c-43f6-b78c-53e25f2240c1 |title=Quiet Shift In Deportation Centers Alarms Local Attorneys, Families |work=WBEZ |access-date=2025-10-12}}</ref> In 2019 several security upgrades such as surveillance cameras were installed.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 March 2019 |title=IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (ICE) BROADVIEW SECURITY FEATURES CONSTRUCTION SOLICITATION AND SPECIFICATIONS |url=https://iae-fbo-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/fbo/files/3ae/3aeffd44f110c3977b904e5c08e8fe3a.pdf?response-content-disposition=attachment%3B%20filename%3DRFQ_W912P619Q0005_BROADVIEW_ICE_SECURITY_UPGRADES.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260310212019/https://iae-fbo-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/fbo/files/3ae/3aeffd44f110c3977b904e5c08e8fe3a.pdf?response-content-disposition=attachment%3B%20filename%3DRFQ_W912P619Q0005_BROADVIEW_ICE_SECURITY_UPGRADES.pdf |archive-date=10 March 2026 |website=iae-fbo-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com}} </ref> The location has functioned as a federal immigration processing center for many years.<ref name=":0" />

Beginning in December 2006, [[Presbyterian Church (USA)|Presbyterian]] pastor David Black organized weekly clergy gatherings to pray outside the facility on Friday mornings.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Campa |first=Camilla Forte, Aydali |date=2025-10-28 |title=Religious Activists Protested Broadview for Years. Now, ICE’s Crackdown Is Drowning Out Their Prayers – Top Stories |url=https://borderlessmag.org/2025/10/28/chicago-broadview-facility-immigration-dhs-detainees-faith-resistance/ |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=Borderless Magazine NFP |language=en-US}}</ref> He was soon joined by attorney Royal Berg and [[Sisters of Mercy|Sisters]] [[Pat Murphy and JoAnn Persch|JoAnn Persch and Pat Murphy]], who formed the Illinois Community for Displaced Immigrants and led advocacy efforts for the passage of a 2008 Illinois law that mandated that immigrants in detention can access spiritual care.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Michelle |title=New Illinois law allows pastoral workers to visit immigrant detainees |url=https://www.ncronline.org/news/new-illinois-law-allows-pastoral-workers-visit-immigrant-detainees |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=National Catholic Reporter |language=en}}</ref> The Friday morning protests have continued for over nineteen years.  

Since the start of [[Operation Midway Blitz]] in late 2025, Broadview has been the scene of many protests, incidents, and court actions.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Kaufman |first1=Elyssa |last2=Franza |first2=Sabrina |last3=Feurer |first3=Todd |last4=Olsen |first4=Dylan |date=2025-10-10 |title=Judge orders fence outside Broadview ICE facility to be removed by Tuesday night |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/news/ice-facility-in-broadview-police-department-protest/ |access-date=2025-10-11 |website=CBS Chicago |language=en-US}}</ref> "Inhumane conditions" such as "poor ventilation" and "cramped cells" and lack of access to lawyers<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lum |first=Joanie |date=2025-10-06 |title=Oak Park Twp. trustee detained during Broadview ICE protests, officials say |url=https://www.fox32chicago.com/news/oak-park-official-detained-ice |access-date=2025-10-12 |website=FOX 32 Chicago |language=en-US}}</ref> have been reported at the facility in 2025,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Wojciechowski |first=Charlie |date=2025-10-02 |title=What's it like inside the Broadview ICE facility? Arrested protester shares his story |url=https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/inside-broadview-ice-facility-arrested-protester-shares-view/3832911/ |access-date=2025-10-12 |website=NBC Chicago |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2025-09-25 |title=Broadview ICE Facility Sparks Complaints of Inhumane Conditions |url=https://news.wttw.com/2025/09/25/broadview-ice-facility-sparks-complaints-inhumane-conditions |access-date=2025-10-11 |website=WTTW News |agency=Associated Press}}</ref> although the [[United States Department of Homeland Security]] has denied these claims.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-07-14 |title=FACT CHECK: ICE Provides Multiple Meals Per Day to Criminal Illegal Aliens Held at Detention Facilities |url=https://www.dhs.gov/news/2025/07/14/fact-check-ice-provides-multiple-meals-day-criminal-illegal-aliens-held-detention |access-date=2025-10-12 |website=www.dhs.gov |language=en}}</ref> There have also been reports of dubious emergency calls to local police originating from the facility.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Ferguson |first=Malcolm |date=2025-10-06 |title=ICE's Growing Feud With Chicago Police Now Includes Fake 911 Calls |url=https://newrepublic.com/post/201394/ice-chicago-police-fake-911-calls |access-date=2025-10-12 |magazine=The New Republic |issn=0028-6583}}</ref> 

[[File:No More Deportations protest at the Broadview ICE facility 10 3 25 20251003 3368 (54829792982).jpg|thumb|right|200px|On October 2, 2025, barricades were constructed.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Heather |first=Kade |date=2025-10-03 |title=New barricades erected near Broadview ICE facility to limit protesters blocking street |url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/immigration/2025/10/02/local-authorities-to-place-barricades-outside-broadview-ice-facility-to-protect-first-amendment-rights |access-date=2025-10-13 |website=Chicago Sun-Times |language=en}}</ref>]]

The windows of the building are boarded up {{As of|2025|October|11|df=US|lc=y}}, reportedly due to security concerns.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Janssen |first=Emma |date=2025-10-06 |title=How ICE Hides Detainees From Their Lawyers |url=https://prospect.org/api/content/a52fd63e-a0a1-11f0-bf4c-1248ae80e59d/ |access-date=2025-10-12 |website=The American Prospect |language=en-us}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last1=McCann |first1=Julie BosmanAllison |last2=McCann |first2=Arijeta LajkaJulie Bosman reported from Chicago Allison |last3=York |first3=Arijeta Lajka reported from New |date=2025-10-12 |title=How Trump's Chicago Immigration Crackdown Escalated, in 10 Videos |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/12/us/chicago-immigration-crackdown-videos.html |access-date=2025-10-26 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref>

[[File:Holy Eucharist procession to Broadview 10 11 2025 20251011 0914 (54849783809).jpg|thumb|right|200px|A procession offering Catholic Eucharist by the facility on October 11, 2025]]
On October 12, 2025, a procession offering Catholic [[Eucharist]] to detainees was denied.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sulek |first=Marissa |date=2025-10-13 |title=Religious leaders offering communion to detainees turned away at Broadview ICE facility |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/news/religious-leaders-turned-away-broadview-ice-facility/ |access-date=2025-10-13 |website=[[CBS Chicago]]|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last1=Kang |first1=Esther Yoon-Ji |last2=Miller |first2=Violet |date=2025-10-11 |title=Religious leaders are denied request to deliver Communion to detainees at Broadview facility |url=https://www.wbez.org/immigration/2025/10/11/broadview-detention-immigration-enforcement-ice-religious-leaders-communion-fence-protests |access-date=2025-10-14 |website=WBEZ |language=en-US}}</ref>

On September 23, 2025, wire riot fence was installed outside the facility in an attempt to prevent protesters from getting too close or blocking ICE vehicles as they enter and leave the facility.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-09-23 |title=Fence goes up outside ICE facility in Broadview, Illinois - CBS Chicago |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/news/fence-goes-up-outside-ice-facility-in-broadview-illinois/ |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=www.cbsnews.com |language=en-US}}</ref> Village officials later sued over the fence claiming that the fence blocked public road and could impact first responders at the scene. A federal judge later ordered the fencing to be removed in a ruling on October 5, 2025, with the fencing being removed on October 10, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-10 |title=Judge orders fence outside Broadview ICE facility to be removed by Tuesday night - CBS Chicago |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/news/ice-facility-in-broadview-police-department-protest/ |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=www.cbsnews.com |language=en-US}}</ref> A November 2025 lawsuit alleged inhumane conditions in the facility. According to the lawsuit, detainees were denied access to bathrooms, clean beds, legal representation and contact with the outside world.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Byrnes |first=Dave |date=2025-11-03 |title=Lawsuit Alleges Inhumane Conditions at Broadview ICE Facility |url=https://southsideweekly.com/lawsuit-over-conditions-at-broadview-ice-facility-in-federal-court/ |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=South Side Weekly |language=en-US}}</ref>
